item.tib: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor las mi shig g.yung drung tshe yi 'phyong
item.coloph: ces 'chi med gsang ba tshe yi sgrub pa/ dwangs ma bcud du 'gugs pa'i thar lam/ bla tshe mi 'gyur srog gi ka ba/ 'chi med g.yung drung tshe yi rdzong chen/ gsang bdag dpal bo chen po'i zhal lung / tshe bdud rang grol srog gi ti ka/ zab lam gsang ba snying gi rgya can 'di yang / dpal snya chen mchog gis (gi) gar rol sa gsum las 'gran zla bral zhing kaH dag bon gyi skur mngon par brnyes pa'i/ khyung dkar grub pa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis (gyi) yang srid kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin grags pa'i gser khri la mnga' gsol ba'i bstan 'gro'i dad (ded) dpon 7spyang 'phags gdung byon 7mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags mchog gis zhal gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang / ma zad mkhas pa'i nor la dbang ba'i drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims dang stag rgod drang srong dbang 'dus gnyis nas yang yang du bskul ba la brten nas/ lha mchog rig 'dzin chen po'i zhal lung mngon par thob pa'i kho bo tha shal ba/ mdo smad zhig po bco brgyad kyi nang tshan shel zhig gdung rgyud rgyal po drug gi nang nas rgod rje rgya yi gdung las dal rten rnyed pa'i/ tshe dbang bla ma'i rjesa'abrang 7tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni 7g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa'i zol po te rgan pa spang phal pa ci lta ba des/ gangs can byang gi sa gnas/ hor sog sde'i tha grur/ dbal gyi phur pa nag po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog dam can ma mo sde lnga rtag tu 'khor zhing sdong grogs g.yel med mdzad pa'i g.yung drung bon gyi me ro spar ba'i rlung g.yab dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du dus dang skabs la bab nas gegs med du grub pas/ dga' ston rten 'brel rtags su dkar chag yi ger phab nas phul ba'o//
